name: Notion to Linear Bug Triage
summary: Turn tagged Notion customer feedback rows into prioritized Linear issues automatically.
setup_steps: Filter Notion database items marked as Bug and Ready for Triage.
Map title, severity tag, and customer context to Linear issue fields.
Write the created Linear issue URL back to Notion to prevent duplicates.
monetization_angle: Target lean product teams that log feedback in Notion but track engineering sprints in Linear.

name: Stripe to Slack Payment Alerts
summary: Send instant Slack alerts whenever a new subscription payment succeeds or fails.
setup_steps: Create a Slack incoming webhook URL for your billing channel.
Subscribe to checkout.session.completed and invoice.payment_failed events in Stripe.
Post formatted event payloads to Slack with customer and plan details.
monetization_angle: Offer as a lightweight paid add-on for indie SaaS founders wanting zero-config alerts.

name: HubSpot Charticheckout Sync
summary: Automates the creation of checkout links in Charticheckout for every new deal marked as 'Closed-Won' in HubSpot. This eliminates manual data entry and ensures immediate payment collection.
setup_steps: Create a webhook trigger in HubSpot for the 'Deal Changed' event filtered by stage 'Closed-Won'.
Map the HubSpot deal amount and customer name to the Charticheckout API payload fields.
Deploy the middleware to send the POST request and log the generated checkout URL back to the HubSpot deal properties.
monetization_angle: Charge a flat monthly fee per connected workspace, targeting small e-commerce teams who rely on both platforms for sales operations.

name: Calendly Airtable Meeting Notes
summary: Pushes metadata from completed Calendly events into pre-configured Airtable bases to automatically log customer interactions. This creates a searchable history of all sales calls without manual logging.
setup_steps: Set up a Calendly webhook to listen for the 'invitee_confirmed' event type.
Use a serverless function to transform the event data into Airtable's record creation format.
Send the data to the specific Airtable table ID via the API key provided by the user.
monetization_angle: Offer a freemium model where basic logging is free, but advanced features like automatic follow-up task creation in Airtable require a premium subscription.

name: GitHub PR Review Trello Sync
summary: Automatically creates Trello cards from GitHub Pull Request reviews to track code quality feedback and action items outside the codebase.
setup_steps: Connect GitHub and Trello accounts via OAuth.
Map PR review comments to specific Trello lists and labels.
Enable webhook triggers for new reviews on selected repositories.
monetization_angle: Charge a monthly subscription for teams exceeding a certain number of repositories or board updates.

name: Shopify to Mailchimp Dynamic Segmentation
summary: Syncs real-time Shopify order data to create or update Mailchimp audience segments based on purchase history and customer lifetime value.
setup_steps: Authorize Shopify and Mailchimp API access.
Define segmentation rules based on order tags or totals.
Activate the sync engine to push updates on new orders.
monetization_angle: Offer tiered pricing based on the volume of monthly order events processed.

name: Asana to Intercom Feedback Sync
summary: Automatically create Intercom tickets from new Asana tasks tagged as customer feedback, keeping support teams in sync with project management.
setup_steps: Connect Asana and Intercom via OAuth.
Define task tags that trigger ticket creation.
Map task fields to Intercom ticket details.
monetization_angle: Charge a monthly fee per integration plus a small fee per ticket created.

name: Typeform to Monday.com Lead Sync
summary: Push new Typeform responses into a dedicated Monday.com board, automatically creating lead items with custom fields for follow‑up.
setup_steps: Authorize Typeform and Monday.com.
Choose a Typeform form and a Monday.com board.
Map form fields to board columns.
monetization_angle: Subscription tiered by number of form responses per month, with a free trial.

name: Google Calendar to Notion Meeting Recap
summary: Automatically generate a Notion page for each scheduled Google Calendar event, including agenda, attendees, and a template for meeting minutes.
setup_steps: Connect your Google Calendar and Notion accounts via OAuth.
Define which calendar events trigger a Notion page creation.
Choose a Notion template to populate with event details.
monetization_angle: Charge a monthly fee for unlimited recaps and advanced template customization.

name: Trello to Discord Board Updates
summary: Send real-time Discord notifications for Trello board activities such as card creation, due date changes, and status updates.
setup_steps: Link your Trello and Discord accounts through a bot.
Select the Trello board and channels to monitor.
Configure event triggers and message formats.
monetization_angle: Offer a tiered subscription based on the number of boards and notification frequency.

name: Airtable + Zoom Meeting Notes
summary: Integrate Airtable and Zoom to automatically save meeting notes to Airtable, streamlining note-taking and organization.
setup_steps: Sign up for an Airtable and Zoom account.
Create a new Airtable base for meeting notes and define the necessary fields.
Set up a Zoom webhook to trigger Airtable updates after meetings.
monetization_angle: Businesses can save time and improve consistency by using Airtable as a central repository for meeting notes.

name: Todoist Task Sync Between Accounts
summary: Allow users to sync tasks between two Todoist accounts, enabling seamless task management across personal and work accounts.
setup_steps: Install the Todoist app on mobile devices.
Create two separate Todoist accounts (personal and work).
Enable the Task Sync add-on in each Todoist account.
monetization_angle: Businesses can utilize Todoist's Task Sync feature to streamline task management for remote teams.

name: Stripe to Discord Payment Alerts
summary: Automatically post real-time payment notifications from Stripe directly into a designated Discord channel, keeping your community or team instantly informed about sales activity.
setup_steps: Create a Discord webhook in the target channel.
Set up a Stripe event webhook (e.g., payment_intent.succeeded) to trigger a serverless function.
Configure the function to send a formatted message to the Discord webhook URL.
monetization_angle: Offer a tiered subscription model based on the number of notifications per month, with premium analytics for higher tiers.

name: Google Drive to Discord File Share Notifications
summary: Send instant Discord alerts whenever a new file is added or modified in a specified Google Drive folder, ensuring teams stay up-to-date without leaving Discord.
setup_steps: Generate a Google Drive API service account and enable the Drive API.
Set up a Drive watch on the target folder to receive push notifications.
Create a Discord webhook and configure a function to forward Drive events to the webhook.
monetization_angle: Charge per monitored folder with a free tier for single folder usage and premium plans for multiple folders and advanced filtering.
